Q: IE8 Printing issues with Jqplot A:

You need to use jQuery 1.4.2.

Download the script and replace the link to 1.3.2 with 1.4.2.

There's also a bug in your code, your div is called "chart1" but your script refers to "chart4".

Fix these and you're singing :)

Q: Azure Communication Service: Incoming Call Event Not Triggering in JavaScript A:

I know this is an old thread and you’ve likely already found the answer, but I’m adding this here in case someone else faces the same issue.

Based on your question and the comments, it looks like you’re expecting to receive a PSTN call (an incoming call to a PSTN number purchased through Azure Communication Services). In these scenarios, you cannot use the Client SDK to answer the call, the Client SDK only supports VoIP calls, where someone calls you using your ACS identity (used to generate the user token). It can, however, be used to place outbound PSTN calls, as described in the Quickstart: Outbound call to a telephone number.

Inbound PSTN calls can only be answered using Dynamics Omnichannel or the Call Automation SDK, as documented in Enable inbound telephony calling for Azure Communication Services. So, you’ll need to use Event Grid to route the incoming call. So, you would need to have the Event Grid to route the incoming call. A sample can be found here Incoming call concepts.

Q: Best way to code a hierarchy of SQL domains A:

You can just create the other domain AS domain.text

CREATE DOMAIN domain.name AS domain.text
   CONSTRAINT no_numbers AS (NOT regexp_like(VALUE, '.*[0-9].*'));

Q: I am getting an error of timeout while deploying resources to AWS using Terraform A:

Do you have an endpoints configuration block in your provider definition? It looks like you have an extra space in the value for sts, based on the error message:

sts.ap-south- 1.amazonaws.com

If not then please share your provider definition and also clarify where you are running the terraform apply from - your own machine, or an instance on AWS? If from your own machine, please verify you can connect to sts.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com, as from the error message you are getting a timeout.
